title: Pinned libxml2 reference runner

acceptance.description: Build libxml2 v2.15.4 at exact commit 96498992efa48d52b0e8b83058bd88dbdaf153c1 and implement its XML reference runner against the integrated protocol; record pinned toolchain, configure options, enabled features and provenance.

Run the protocol known XML fixture and compare its normalized response against the integrated BCL runner; exercise invalid requests/input, offline resources and denied unconfigured external access with runner failures distinct from parse rejection.
Demonstrate task-private build scripts/runner and actual checks at known implementation revision using only integrated verified dependencies; preserve earlier behavior and validate task records.

implementation: tools/ReferenceRunners/Libxml2/build.py: immutable upstream fetch/commit checks, exact compiler/CMake/make/SDK/configuration, fresh static builds and checksum/feature/license provenance

tools/ReferenceRunners/Libxml2/bridge.c: real pinned reader, per-request resource loader/error capture, copied offline inputs and native reader scratch cleanup; no global loader or file/network fallback

tools/ReferenceRunners/Libxml2/DocumentEnvelope.cs: conservative post-native unsupported normalization detection for omitted top-level whitespace or ambiguous encoding/envelope; no invented events
tools/ReferenceRunners/Libxml2/AttributeNormalization.cs and Checks/: production UTF16 ordinal sorter and ambiguous-encoding regressions
